decisions.decision: There is no Sneak Attack-specific distance cap; an otherwise valid ranged attack may qualify at normal allowed range, including sniper attacks. Weapon Mastery retains its usual effects; it neither replaces proficiency nor independently creates Sneak Attack eligibility. Ordinary attack restrictions and modifiers still apply; weapon proficiency must be acquired normally. decisions.decision: Extend the unified Sorcerer Metamagic option repertoire with meaningful 3.x-only functions that modern Sorcerer options lack. Specifically include adapted Widen Spell (expand qualifying areas) and Maximize Spell (maximize eligible variable numerical effects). Historical Empower Spell (multiply eligible variable numerical effects) and Heighten Spell (increase effective spell level) remain distinct from modern Empowered Spell (reroll selected dice) and Heightened Spell (saving throw Disadvantage) and must receive distinct, nonredundant treatment under the same approved adaptation principle. Do not assign any native Sorcery Point costs, stack permissions, names, or eligibility rules by inference; those details remain for reconciliation.

decisions.decision: The unified Sorcerer Metamagic class feature adds four owner-approved options with Sorcery Point prices: Amplified Spell (3; raise one eligible initial-resolution rolled variable numerical effect by 50% rounded down on a spell cast at level <=7); Ascendant Spell (2 per effective spell level, adding one or two effective spell levels but not above level 9 or highest Sorcerer castable level; +1 save DC per level, affects level-dependent interactions but not upcast benefits); Widened Spell (4; double eligible dimensions of one continuous spell area, not range or separate-area count; spell cast at level <=6); Maximized Spell (5; maximize one eligible variable numerical roll in initial resolution, including damage/healing but not attack/save/opposed rolls or later recurring rolls; spell cast at level <=6). Restrictions use actual casting level including ordinary upcasting. Amplified + Maximized, if both options are allowed, costs 8 Sorcery Points and yields maximum base result plus half a separately rolled eligible result, rounded down. Exact unusual spell geometry delegated to shared effects implementation.
decisions.decisionBasis: Owner approved the complete preceding Sorcerer Metamagic proposal (including naming, numeric costs, restrictions, Twinned modes, combination limits, progression and capstone discount) on 2026-10-23.

decisions.decision: One learned Twinned Spell option has two mutually exclusive modes. Twin (2014-derived) costs Sorcery Points equal to actual spell casting level, minimum 1, and adds a second creature in range if the spell targets one creature, is not Self-range and cannot target multiple creatures at its current level. Expanded Targeting (2024-derived) costs 1 Sorcery Point, treating a spell as one level higher solely to gain an additional target when its upcasting rules explicitly add targets; no other upcast benefit. Pick one mode per casting; do not use either twice or both together.
decisions.decisionBasis: Owner approved the complete preceding Sorcerer Metamagic proposal (including naming, numeric costs, restrictions, Twinned modes, combination limits, progression and capstone discount) on 2026-10-23.

decisions.decision: Sorcerers know two Metamagic options at class level 2, four at 10, and six at 17, drawing both modern options and adapted historical ones from one pool. On gaining a Sorcerer level, one known option can be replaced with an eligible one. Ordinarily one option affects a spell; the explicit Empowered Spell and Seeking Spell exceptions allow them alongside another option. During active Innate Sorcery with Sorcery Incarnate, at most two different options may affect one spell, paying both costs. No option can be applied twice on the same casting; modern casting-time rules apply, without the generic historical spontaneous-casting full-round penalty.
decisions.decisionBasis: Owner approved the complete preceding Sorcerer Metamagic proposal (including naming, numeric costs, restrictions, Twinned modes, combination limits, progression and capstone discount) on 2026-10-23.

decisions.decision: At Sorcerer class level 20, while Innate Sorcery is active, Arcane Apotheosis discounts at most 2 Sorcery Points from ONE Metamagic option EACH turn, minimum resulting cost 0; it does not make arbitrarily costly options free. The second applied option, if permitted by Sorcery Incarnate, pays full cost. This approval resolves only the capstone Metamagic subsidy; Sorcerous Restoration is separately resolved by the owner-approved additive level-20 recovery rule, without changing this capstone's Metamagic discount.

decisions.decision: Open Spell Access is an optional GM/campaign spellcasting policy separate from the general removal of daily spell preparation. If enabled for an eligible spellcaster, it removes finite known/prepared spell selection counts, granting access to all spells (including cantrips) on the character's class spell list at levels the class permits. No higher class spell level, off-list spells, added casting resources or free castings are thereby conferred. If the option is off, class-specific known-spell progressions remain in force and daily preparation is still removed; Bard retains its currently approved finite known progression, while Cleric and Druid already have separately approved full-list access. Sorcerer's exact finite option-off default progression remains unresolved, as do executable campaign-policy controls. This optional spell-access policy does not remove or change selected Metamagic option limits.
